reply.emotion: straightforward and practical, pointing to the body
notes: Refers to the upper limb from the shoulder to the hand, but in everyday language it often includes the whole arm.

senses.definition: The upper limb of the human body extending from the shoulder to the hand.

examples.text: Ele machucou o braço jogando futebol.
examples.translation: He hurt his arm playing soccer.
examples.emotion: concerned and sympathetic, talking about an injury

senses.definition: The part of a garment that covers the arm.

examples.text: A blusa tem o braço muito comprido.
examples.translation: The blouse has a very long sleeve.
examples.emotion: slightly annoyed while trying on clothes in a shop

senses.definition: A long extension branching out from a main body, river, or object.

examples.text: O barco entrou por um braço do rio.
examples.translation: The boat entered a branch of the river.
examples.emotion: calm and descriptive, observing nature during a boat ride

definitions: The upper limb of the human body extending from the shoulder to the hand.
The part of a garment that covers the arm.
A long extension branching out from a main body, river, or object.
